about: Fixture personas for the relevance evals and the one-click demo. Made-up people; nothing here is any real student's preference. A real student's targets live only in their own profile row, set through the chat or the Profile page.

personas.used_by: the one-click demo profile (Admin > demo-refeed) and evals/relevance
personas.targets: product, consulting, business/data analyst and finance roles; not core software engineering

cvs.label: Product CV
cvs.summary: for product management and product analytics roles; skills: user research, PRDs, SQL, A/B testing, funnel analysis, Figma, roadmapping; experience: product intern at a consumer fintech app (onboarding funnel); winner of a campus product case competition; churn analysis project for a food-delivery app; education: B.Tech, engineering

cvs.label: Consulting CV
cvs.summary: for strategy and management consulting roles; skills: market sizing, business case building, Excel modelling, PowerPoint, stakeholder interviews; experience: strategy intern at a mid-size consulting firm (market entry study); founder's office intern at a logistics startup; lead of the campus consulting club; education: B.Tech, engineering

cvs.label: Analytics & Finance CV
cvs.summary: for business/data analyst, finance and quant roles; skills: SQL, Python (pandas), statistics, Excel financial modelling, valuation, Tableau; experience: data analyst intern at a lending company (credit-risk dashboards); equity research project on Indian banks; finalist in an inter-college quant trading contest; education: B.Tech, engineering

personas.targets: software engineering roles: backend, frontend, full-stack and SDE; not data science, machine learning, product management, consulting, analyst, finance or core (non-software) engineering roles
